messages:
Ria (CS): Quick capture from today's onboarding with ClearCo (Priya). Main asks: per-route billing toggle in Console so their infra team can turn off embedding routes for internal teams; embeddings bulk ingest instability (intermittent 504s/timeouts); and a renewal report export for per-route usage. They're mid-trial and renewal looks contingent on cost visibility.

Noah (Product): Thanks. Can you paste Priya's exact wording about the failures and any repro steps? Marking this as a potential trial-health P1.

Ria (CS): Quote from Priya: "We see spikes where up to half our batches get 504s and it blocks our uploads." Repro notes: they ran ~50k vectors across 3 parallel jobs hitting /v1/embeddings; failure rate ~10-15% after warmup. Sending logs and trace ids to eng. Also they asked for a simple UI toggle per route.

Sam (CS): They also want a CSV export that shows cost per route per day for finance. Critical for renewal conversations.

Owen (Eng): 504s usually point at batching timeouts or fallback thrash. @Noah please share the traces. I'll start with runtime logs and batching metrics for that tenant.

Noah (Product): Can someone open a Jira so we can track? If runtime root cause, we prioritize trace->fix. If config/limits, it's an enablement item. Voting: +1 backlog as "visibility", +2 ship quickly for retention. React to vote.

Ria (CS): Filed initial notes and will attach logs. If reproduces, I recommend we try to fix before EOW; renewal is at risk otherwise.

feedback-bot: Created ticket RF-4150: clearco-embeddings-ingest. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RF-4150 :white_check_mark: 

Noah (Product): Short-term mitigation idea: recommend they segment uploads, reduce concurrency, and add exponential backoff. Sam, can you draft an enablement snippet and a templated email for CSMs?

Sam (CS): On it. Drafting enablement note now; will post to #cs-templates. Include curl snippet for limiting concurrency: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"batch_size":500, "concurrency":2}'``` and steps to export per-route CSV from Console.

Ria (CS): Noting renewal risk: account flagged as "at-risk" if per-route cost transparency isn't resolved within three weeks. I'll update the account health spreadsheet and set a renewal play reminder.

Owen (Eng): Investigation started. Found a few 504 clusters correlated to high concurrency spikes and model fallback events. Posting traces and initial hypothesis to RF-4150 shortly.

Noah (Product): Product plan: triage RF-4150 this sprint. If feasible as a low-risk change, implement a per-route toggle in Console as a Q2 quickship. If not, ship enablement + export work as mitigation. @Ria update account health doc with actions and ETA.

Ria (CS): Will update. Priya said they'd accept the concurrency workaround for now if we provide step-by-step and a temporary CSV export for finance. Following up with them after we post the enablement note.
